h: Lewandowski names his pick for the 2026 Ballon d'Or
p: Robert Lewandowski has reportedly said who he thinks should win this year's Ballon d'Or, choosing from Harry Kane, Lamine Yamal and Kylian Mbappe. The ceremony takes place in London in a few days.
more: Updated rankings were published ahead of the ceremony.
Messi has just won the Princess of Asturias Award.
